correctionsDuringValidation: Moved contribution evaluation from the low-level event append helper to the end of actual simulation ticks, preserving archive fixture semantics and deliberate bounded social credit.

Corrected new test fixture init timestamps, member/creator schema fields, enterprise TypeScript return type and original-engine Mock/off setup.
Fixed opening the dynasty panel before the first server connection completes.
Seeded browser local-world fixtures before app initialization; pagehide otherwise overwrote the fixture with the running previous world.
Adjusted newborn fixture timing to include the existing 36-tick initial clock.
Initial focused browser run 3 passed / 3 failed; corrected run 6 passed; full suite 94 passed / 1 real-model skipped; final focused 3 passed.
limitations: Local authenticated headers do not prove a real invited account login.
Actual Chrome language quality, human-interest evaluation and global production CPU/memory were not tested.
Businesses acquire existing enterprises and sell actual production to the shared market; free-form land plots, private retail orders and credit financing are outside this scope.
Operating profits exclude acquisition cost and may later be reduced by losses; old paid dividends are not clawed back.
Dynasty visit/identity metadata remains account-specific and is not imported from world archives.
